title: Kimi AI and kvcache-ai Open Sources 'AgentENV': A Distributed System that Powers Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) Training for Kimi K3
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Moonshot AI's Kimi team and kvcache-ai open-sourced AgentENV (AENV) under MIT, as part of Kimi K3 Open Day. It runs agent sandboxes as Firecracker microVMs with millisecond snapsho...
body: Kimi AI, in partnership with kvcache-ai, has open-sourced AgentENV, a distributed system designed specifically for running complex AI agent workflows. AgentENV manages tool executions, state rollbacks, and parallel reasoning steps across multiple servers, reducing latency and resource footprint. This release aims to provide developers with a robust backbone for building enterprise-grade agent swarms. The framework simplifies orchestrating long-running autonomous processes, ensuring high reliability even when external API dependencies or tools experience intermittent downtime. It represents a solid open-source contribution to the community.
